# TrikMed API Reference

**Base URL:** `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL` (default: `http://localhost:8000`)  
**Auth:** All authenticated endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer <token>`  
**Interactive docs:** `http://localhost:8000/docs` (Swagger UI, auto-generated by FastAPI)

All request and response bodies are JSON (`Content-Type: application/json`).

---

## Authentication

| Method | Endpoint | Auth | Description |
|--------|----------|------|-------------|
| `POST` | `/auth/login` | — | Login for clinic or portal admin accounts |
| `POST` | `/auth/staff-login` | — | PIN-based login for clinic staff (by phone + PIN) |
| `POST` | `/auth/signup` | — | Register a new clinic (creates clinic + owner account, status = `pending_approval`) |
| `POST` | `/auth/logout` | ✓ | Invalidate session (client must discard token) |
| `GET` | `/auth/me` | ✓ | Get the currently authenticated user |
| `POST` | `/auth/forgot-password` | — | Request a password reset (stub — returns success) |
| `POST` | `/auth/reset-password` | — | Reset password with token (stub — returns success) |

### `POST /auth/login`
```json
// Request
{ "email": "doctor@clinic.com", "password": "secret", "role": "clinic" }
// role: "clinic" | "admin"

// Response
{ "token": "<jwt>", "user": { "id", "name", "email", "role", "clinic_id", "clinic_role", "custom_permissions", ... } }
```

### `POST /auth/staff-login`
```json
// Request
{ "clinic_id": "CLN-XXXXXX", "phone": "9876543210", "pin": "1234" }

// Response
{ "token": "<jwt>", "user": { ... } }
```

### `POST /auth/signup`
```json
// Request
{ "clinic_name": "Apollo Clinic", "doctor_name": "Dr. Mehta", "email": "dr@clinic.com", "phone": "9876543210", "password": "secret123" }

// Response
{ "success": true, "status": "pending_approval", "message": "...", "clinic": {...}, "user": {...} }
```

**User roles in JWT:** `clinic`, `admin`, `super`, `zone`, `city`, `sales`, `mr`, `installer`  
**Clinic roles:** `doctor_owner`, `owner`, `doctor`, `receptionist`, `staff`

## Staff Management

All endpoints require a clinic JWT. Create/update/delete require `clinic_role` of `owner`, `doctor_owner`, or `doctor`.

| Method | Endpoint | Auth | Description |
|--------|----------|------|-------------|
| `GET` | `/staff` | ✓ clinic | List all staff for the caller's clinic |
| `POST` | `/staff` | ✓ owner | Add a new staff member |
| `PATCH` | `/staff/{staff_id}` | ✓ owner | Update role or active status |
| `DELETE` | `/staff/{staff_id}` | ✓ owner | Remove a staff member |
| `PATCH` | `/staff/{staff_id}/permissions` | ✓ owner | Set granular custom permissions |
| `GET` | `/staff/activity` | ✓ clinic | Get activity log (filter by `?staff_id=&date=`) |

### `POST /staff`
```json
// Request
{ "name": "Priya R", "phone": "9876543210", "email": "priya@clinic.com", "clinic_role": "receptionist", "pin": "4321" }

// Response
{ "id": "STF-XXXXXXXX", "name": "Priya R", "clinic_role": "receptionist", "login_id": "9876543210", "temp_password": "4321", ... }
```

### `PATCH /staff/{staff_id}/permissions`
```json
// Request
{ "custom_permissions": { "view_patients": true, "send_whatsapp": false, "export_data": false } }
```

## Queue

| Method | Endpoint | Auth | Description |
|--------|----------|------|-------------|
| `GET` | `/queue/today` | ✓ clinic | Get today's live queue (sorted by token number) |
| `POST` | `/queue/walkin` | ✓ clinic | Add a walk-in patient to the queue |

### `POST /queue/walkin`
```json
// Request
{
  "name": "Ramesh Kumar",
  "phone": "9876543210",
  "age": 35,
  "gender": "Male",
  "address": "123 MG Road",
  "emergency": "Wife: 9898989898",
  "complaint": "Fever and cough",
  "doctorId": "USR-XXXXXXXX",
  "appointmentDate": "2026-06-14",
  "appointmentTime": "10:30",
  "paymentAmount": 300,
  "paymentMode": "cash",
  "consultationType": "new",
  "vitals": { "bp": "120/80", "spo2": "98", "weight": "70" }
}

// Response
{ "patient": {...}, "appointment": {...}, "payment": {...} }
```

**Queue status flow:** `booked` → `paid` → `vitals_done` → `in_cabin` → `completed` / `no_show` / `cancelled`

## Clinics

| Method | Endpoint | Auth | Description |
|--------|----------|------|-------------|
| `POST` | `/clinics` | ✓ any | Create a clinic (self-serve — creates with status `trial`) |
| `GET` | `/clinics/{clinic_id}` | ✓ any | Get a single clinic (clinic users can only fetch their own) |
| `PATCH` | `/clinics/{clinic_id}` | ✓ any | Update clinic details |
| `GET` | `/clinics/{clinic_id}/qr` | ✓ clinic | Get the clinic's QR booking URL and display info |

### `GET /clinics/{clinic_id}/qr`
```json
// Response
{
  "clinic_name": "Apollo Clinic",
  "booking_url": "https://trikmed.in/q/TM8K4P9D",
  "qr_code": "TM8K4P9D"
}
```

### `GET /q/{qr_code}`
Redirects to `https://wa.me/<WHATSAPP_NUMBER>?text=START%20<QR_CODE>` when the QR exists, is active, and its clinic exists. Invalid, inactive, malformed, or orphaned QR codes return a generic `404`.

## Portal — Internal Ops

All portal endpoints require a portal JWT (any non-`clinic` role).

| Method | Endpoint | Auth | Description |
|--------|----------|------|-------------|
| `GET` | `/portal/overview` | ✓ portal | Company-wide stats: total clinics, active, revenue, by zone |
| `GET` | `/portal/clinics` | ✓ portal | List all clinics (filter by `?city=&zone=&status=&plan=&search=`) |
| `POST` | `/portal/clinics` | ✓ portal | Create a clinic with immediate approval (requires login email + password) |
| `GET` | `/portal/clinics/{clinic_id}` | ✓ portal | Get single clinic detail |
| `GET` | `/portal/onboardings` | ✓ portal | Onboarding queue (status: `pending_approval`, `approved`, `rejected`, `trial`) |
| `PATCH` | `/portal/onboardings/{clinic_id}` | ✓ portal | Approve / reject / update onboarding status |
| `GET` | `/portal/team` | ✓ portal | List all portal team members |
| `GET` | `/portal/dashboard` | ✓ portal | Portal dashboard stats |
| `GET` | `/portal/demo-requests` | ✓ portal | List all demo requests submitted via landing page |

### `POST /portal/clinics` (admin-created clinic)
```json
// Request
{
  "clinic_name": "Shree Clinic", "doctor_name": "Dr. Patel",
  "contact_phone": "9876543210", "city": "Pune", "zone": "West",
  "plan_type": "Growth", "login_email": "dr@shreeclinic.com", "login_password": "secure123"
}

// Response includes login_email and login_user_id
```

## MR Manager — Clinic-Side

Manages Medical Representatives visiting a clinic. All endpoints require a clinic JWT.

### MR Registration

| Method | Endpoint | Auth | Description |
|--------|----------|------|-------------|
| `GET` | `/mr` | ✓ clinic | List all MRs for the clinic |
| `POST` | `/mr` | ✓ clinic | Register a new MR |
| `PATCH` | `/mr/{mr_id}` | ✓ clinic | Update MR profile |
| `POST` | `/mr/{mr_id}/block` | ✓ clinic | Block an MR (requires reason) |
| `POST` | `/mr/{mr_id}/unblock` | ✓ clinic | Unblock an MR |
| `DELETE` | `/mr/{mr_id}` | ✓ clinic | Delete an MR |

### `POST /mr`
```json
// Request
{
  "full_name": "Vikram Singh",
  "phone": "9876543210",
  "email": "vikram@pharma.com",
  "company_name": "Sun Pharma",
  "designation": "Territory Manager",
  "territory": "Nagpur East",
  "products_represented": ["Pantocid", "Dolo 650"],
  "visiting_card_url": null,
  "notes": "Visits on Tuesdays"
}
```

### MR Appointments (Slot Booking)

Endpoints live in `backend/routers/mr_appointments.py`, mounted under `/mr-appointments`:

| Method | Endpoint | Auth | Description |
|--------|----------|------|-------------|
| `POST` | `/mr-appointments` | ✓ clinic | Book a slot for an MR |
| `GET` | `/mr-appointments` | ✓ clinic | List all MR appointments |
| `GET` | `/mr-appointments/today` | ✓ clinic | Today's MR appointment queue |
| `GET` | `/mr-appointments/upcoming` | ✓ clinic | Upcoming MR appointments |
| `PATCH` | `/mr-appointments/{apt_id}` | ✓ clinic | Update appointment status |
| `DELETE` | `/mr-appointments/{apt_id}` | ✓ clinic | Cancel appointment |
| `POST` | `/mr-appointments/{apt_id}/start` | ✓ clinic | Mark meeting started |
| `POST` | `/mr-appointments/{apt_id}/complete` | ✓ clinic | Mark meeting completed |

### Meeting Hours (Slot Configuration)

Endpoints live in `backend/routers/mr_meeting_hours.py`:

| Method | Endpoint | Auth | Description |
|--------|----------|------|-------------|
| `GET` | `/mr-meeting-hours` | ✓ clinic | Get configured meeting windows per weekday |
| `PUT` | `/mr-meeting-hours` | ✓ clinic | Set meeting windows (replaces all) |
| `GET` | `/mr-meeting-hours/available-slots` | ✓ clinic | Get available 20-min slots for a given date |

### MR Visit Logs

Endpoints live in `backend/routers/mr_visits.py`:

| Method | Endpoint | Auth | Description |
|--------|----------|------|-------------|
| `POST` | `/mr-visits` | ✓ clinic | Log a post-visit record |
| `GET` | `/mr-visits` | ✓ clinic | List visit logs (filter by `?mr_id=&date=`) |
| `GET` | `/mr-visits/summary` | ✓ clinic | Visit summary stats per MR |
| `PATCH` | `/mr-visits/{visit_id}` | ✓ clinic | Update a visit log |

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| `GET` | `/public/clinics` | List of clinics (id, name, doctor, city, status) — used by demo login selector |

## Dev Shortcut

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| `POST` | `/dev/demo-login` | Bypass password — issues a real token for a given `user_id`. Only works when `TRIKMED_DEV_SHORTCUTS != false`. |

```json
// Request
{ "user_id": "USR-XXXXXXXX" }

// Response: same shape as /auth/login
{ "token": "...", "user": {...} }
```

> **⚠ Warning:** Disable this in production by setting `TRIKMED_DEV_SHORTCUTS=false` in your backend environment.

---

## Error Response Format

All errors follow FastAPI's default format:

```json
{ "detail": "Human-readable error message" }
```

| HTTP Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `400` | Bad request / validation error |
| `401` | Missing or invalid token |
| `403` | Forbidden — wrong role or insufficient permissions |
| `404` | Resource not found |
| `409` | Conflict — duplicate (email, phone, etc.) |
| `422` | Unprocessable entity — Pydantic validation failure |
